IDT12420.name: Derwent Estuary
IDT12420.text:
Monday 16 November
Winds: Westerly 10 to 15 knots turning northwesterly below 10 knots in the late evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Tuesday 17 November
Winds: Northwesterly below 10 knots tending westerly 10 to 15 knots in the morning then tending southwesterly 15 to 20 knots in the middle of the day.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Wednesday 18 November
Winds: West to southwesterly about 10 knots tending southeasterly 10 to 15 knots during the day then becoming variable about 10 knots during the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Thursday 19 November
Winds: Variable below 10 knots becoming southeasterly 10 to 15 knots during the day then becoming easterly below 10 knots during the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Mostly sunny.
IDT12420.synoptic: A southwesterly flow persists across Tasmania in the wake of a cold front. A series of troughs in the southwesterly flow are expected to cross the south of Tasmania on Monday and Tuesday. A high pressure system then establishes over Tasmania on Wednesday bringing settled conditions, persisting into Thursday.

IDT12326.name: South East Coast
IDT12326.text:
Monday 16 November
Winds: Westerly 20 to 25 knots increasing to 20 to 30 knots in the morning.
Seas: 1.5 to 2 metres, increasing to 2 to 3 metres during the morning.
Swell: Southwesterly 2 to 3 metres inshore, increasing to 3 to 4 metres offshore.
Weather: Cloudy. 50% chance of showers.

Tuesday 17 November
Winds: Westerly 20 to 30 knots turning southwesterly in the late morning.
Seas: 2 to 3 metres.
Swell: Southwesterly 2.5 to 3 metres inshore, increasing to 3 to 4 metres offshore.
Weather: Cloudy. 70% chance of showers.

Wednesday 18 November
Winds: Southwesterly 15 to 20 knots becoming variable about 10 knots during the morning.
Seas: 1 to 2 metres, decreasing below 1 metre during the morning.
Swell: Southwesterly 3 to 4 metres.
Weather: Cloudy.
